job.text: en to the Campagna at Rome. But we had to tear ourselves away from this Arcadia, for in the midst of the farm-yard appeared the carriage and Charles. So we jolted back--it seemed as if Cornish carriages and horses could go anywhere and over everything--to the Old Inn and Mary Mundy. She _had_ come home, and everything was right. As we soon found, everything and everybody was accustomed to be put to rights by Miss Mary Mundy. She stood at the door to greet us--a bright, brown-faced little woman with the reddest of cheeks and the blackest of eyes
